title: Plugin market
intro: Plugins that passed an AI code review and a maintainer's approval. Installing downloads the approved commit from GitHub. To submit or publish a plugin, use the plugin store website.
empty: The plugin market has no plugins yet.
installed: Plugin installed. Configure and enable it under Installed.

confirm.title: Install {name}?
confirm.source: Downloads {repo} at commit {commit} (version {version}) from GitHub and installs it as {id}.
confirm.noticesLead: The review found the behaviour below. It isn't necessarily harmful, but you may want to know first.
confirm.noNotices: The review found nothing users need to be told about.
confirm.sandbox: Plugins run inside the bot's process with no sandbox and the same permissions as the bot. Only install plugins you trust.
confirm.incompatible: This plugin needs framework version {range}; this version may not be able to load it.

kinds.data_sharing: Data sent to a third party

sources.title: Plugin sources
sources.label: Plugin index URLs
sources.hint: One plugin index URL per line; takes effect once saved. When two sources list the same ID, the one higher up wins. Whatever the source, plugin code is only downloaded from GitHub.
sources.stale: Couldn't read {url} ({error}); showing the copy cached at {time}.
sources.failed: Couldn't read {url} ({error}), and there is no cached copy.
sources.dropped_one: {count} entry in {url} has the wrong format and was skipped.
sources.dropped_other: {count} entries in {url} have the wrong format and were skipped.
